report.summary: The display abort is fixed at the call site — the board panel's sub_type is \"rgb\", so lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb() replaces the asserting generic add path — and the esp-dsp crash is confirmed gone by the functional run; the only remaining item is the stray app_audio/CMakeLists.txt.new draft, still unfixed (warning).

report.dataModel: No Matter/RainMaker model. MQTT: publish {"current_heating_setpoint": "<x.y>"} to zigbee2mqtt/<TRV> (qos1, retain 0); {"time": 254} to zigbee2mqtt/bridge/request/permit_join; subscribe each TRV state topic and each air-sensor topic per session; retained status zerocode/<mac12>/status with last-will. HTTP /settings (GET/POST), /api/state, /api/set.

bootSequence: app_audio_init (generic DSP kernel, 21-phrase vocabulary, AFE + WakeNet)
app_display_init -> display_setup_task: lvgl_port_init, lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb for the RGB panel, lvgl_port_add_touch
heating_ui_init (1500 ms wait, LVGL lock, room cards, press/release event cbs, ui 250 ms / listen 1000 ms timers)
app_mqtt_init (loads NVS config incl. CA, then STA or onboarding AP)
expectedLogPatterns: app_audio: "DSP dot product: generic kernel linked (generic C (app_dsp_shim))"
heating_voice: "21 of 21 phrases registered"; app_audio: "Voice framework initialized"
app_display: "Display setup started", "Panel 'display_lcd' from board 'esp32_s31_korvo_1': generic_rgb rgb 800x480" with no "(not registered)" suffix, then "Display initialized"
app_mqtt: "MQTT initialized (node <mac>)"; "MQTT connecting to mqtts://homeassistant.gdenu.fi:8123 (TLS, certificate name check skipped)" on a fresh panel

gpios.function: BOOT button — click push-to-talk, long press permit-join / reopen onboarding AP
adc_button_group handles[0]: click push-to-talk, double click dismiss, 1 s hold arms a 10 s factory reset
on-board RGB LCD (800x480, board-owned frame buffer)

notes: The display abort is fixed at the call site: the board panel's sub_type is "rgb" (gen_board_device_config.c:318-322), so lvgl_port_add_disp_rgb() is taken and the previous assert(io_handle != NULL) path is no longer reachable.
artifacts/device.log still holds the previous (aborting) build; the RGB fix has not yet been observed on a booted image.
Factory reset remains a 10 s single-button hold (documented deviation from the spec's SET+MODE).
TLS keeps skip_cert_common_name_check for every mqtts/ssl/:8883 URI (owner's request) with an optional persisted pinned CA.
The stray firmware/components/app_audio/CMakeLists.txt.new is still in the tree.

peripherals.driver: app_audio (AFE + MultiNet) on app_dsp_shim's generic dot product
app_mqtt (STA + onboarding SoftAP, CA in NVS)

findings.description: The stray draft firmware/components/app_audio/CMakeLists.txt.new (registers a SRCS entry "dsp_probe.c" that exists nowhere) is still in the tree from two rounds ago.
findings.evidence: firmware/components/app_audio/CMakeLists.txt.new:8-12 `idf_component_register(SRCS "app_audio.cpp" "dsp_probe.c" …)`; the real CMakeLists.txt has no such entry and no dsp_probe.c exists under components/app_audio/.
findings.failureScenario: Anyone who copies the .new draft over CMakeLists.txt (its name and content invite it) makes app_audio fail to configure with a missing source file, and the voice framework disappears from the image.
findings.suggestedChange: Delete the stray CMakeLists.txt.new from the tree.
